messages:
Matt: heads-up — deploybot rejected the image publish for `infra-service:build-20260315-42`.
Matt: error in CI log: `publish failed: provenance check failed: manifest 'sha256:abc123...' references a symlinked manifestlist -> rejected by provenance guard`
Matt: i'm attaching the snippet we get from deploybot:
```
deploybot: publish failed
  repo: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/infra-service
  tag: build-20260315-42
  error: provenance check failed: manifest 'sha256:abc123' -> points to manifestlist via symlink
  action: reject
```
Ravi: ugh, that symlinked manifestlist thing — sounds like our mirror/multi-arch pipeline replaced the single-arch manifest with a pointer. I've seen this when `manifest-tool` deduped and created a manifest list that references older manifests by symlink.
Jen: can we just retag the digest and re-push the single-arch manifest? quick fix is to push `infra-service:build-20260315-42-priv` with the explicit sha digest pinned.
Nora: i think we should avoid hotfix pushes outside the change window unless it's a P0. This is blocking the release but not a security incident. Change window is at 02:00 UTC.
ops-sre: suggestion — flatten the manifest when copying from the internal builder registry to ECR. `skopeo copy --all` sometimes preserves lists; use `--dest-no-preserve=all` (or `--all --remove-signatures`) so the resulting manifest is the single-arch one.
Matt: can you paste the skopeo command you'd run?
ops-sre: something like:
```
skopeo copy \  
  --dest-no-preserve=all \  
  docker://internal-registry/infra-service:build-20260315-42 \  
  docker://123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/infra-service:build-20260315-42
```
Ravi: alternative: retag to the pinned digest and let deploybot accept it. Deploybot's provenance check allows pinned digest pushes if provenance points directly to blob. Not if it points to a manifestlist.
Jen: quick plan proposal:
- hold rollouts until change window (Nora + PM ok?)
- in parallel, try local skopeo flattening and test publish to a staging repo
- if staging publish passes provenance, promote the pinned digest to production during window
- update release notes to indicate image pinned to SHA and reason
Nora: PM confirmed — prefer scheduled promote during window. No emergency override.
Matt: i ran the skopeo copy as ops-sre suggested to a staging repo and deploybot accepted it. logs:
```
INFO: copied manifest sha256:def456 to staging repo
deploybot: publish ok (staging)
```
Matt: so we can do the promote during window. Ops team will run the flatten copy and then trigger deploybot promote to prod-tag `build-20260315-42` -> pinned digest.
Jen: i will update the release notes: add line "Image pinned to sha256:def456 in response to manifestlist/provenance validation" and add an action item to postmortem the multi-arch pipeline.
Ravi: i'll open a follow-up ticket to make the flattening step part of the build pipeline so this doesn't recur.
ops-sre: once promoted, we'll run a quick smoke canary for 10 minutes and abort if errors > 5%.
deploy-bot: ack — will allow promote flow during approved change window if ops-sre triggers promote and includes `--promote-author=ops-sre` flag.
Matt: thanks all. i'll mark the release as held and add the promote checklist. :thumbsup:
Jen: tx — i'll attach the updated release notes and tag the release candidate as `held-for-provenance`
Nora: thanks — good catch. We'll follow up in postmortems. :spiral_note_pad:
